description: Search get4agent's catalog of services and data APIs from Regent-verified sellers, newest first. Each result has a price, the seller, the date it was added and a url to buy on get4agent.com. Results are paged: has_more and next_offset tell whether more results exist and where the next page starts. Public, no sign-in.

kind.description: listing kind: good | service | api | tool

offset.description: number of results to skip, e.g. 20 for the second page of 20 (default 0)

query.description: keyword matched against title and description, e.g. "courier"

verified_only.description: only sellers whose identity Regent verified (default true)

name: search_listings
title: Search the marketplace
